CVeyra / Shizuku-Next attribution

Parts of CVeyra's privacy-module behavior, package networking control research, and ADB start-flow design were adapted from:

Shizuku-Next
Repository: https://github.com/rushiranpise/Shizuku-Next
Reference release: v14.0.13-next
License: GNU General Public License v3.0

Veyra does not copy Shizuku-Next's visual design. CVeyra uses its own UI, privilege model, VeyraKSU integration, backup/migration flow, firewall persistence layer, and permission-provider architecture.

This notice is bundled with Veyra source/assets to preserve attribution for the referenced GPL-licensed work.
